title: grammitis pumila
intro: Grammitis pumila, commonly known as the Dwarf Grammitis or Small Rock Cap Fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, providing relief from inflammation and pain. The health benefits of Grammitis pumila are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are believed to be due to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents of Grammitis pumila and its potential therapeutic applications.
